---
title: "mHTI Funding"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

var_names <- c(
  "record_id",
  "name",
  "Participants",
  "Cohort",
  "stage",
  "com_discipline",
  "region",
  "Role",
  "Title",
  "Abstract",
  "Award Type",
  "Amount",
  "Start Date",
  "End Date",
  "agency",
  "mhealth_classification"
)
```



```{r, include=FALSE}
data <- read_excel("data_merged_classified.xlsx", sheet = 1)[,var_names]


data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    `Award Category` = case_when(
      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R01", "R03", "R21", "R34", "R37", "R56", "RF1"
      ) ~ "Research Projects",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "U01", "R61", "R33", "UG3", "R18"
      ) ~ "Cooperative / Multi-component Research",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "K01", "K08", "K23", "K24", "R00"
      ) ~ "Career Development & Transition",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "T32", "F30", "D43"
      ) ~ "Training & Fellowships",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "P30", "P50", "U48", "UM1"
      ) ~ "Centers & Large Research Programs",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R41", "R42", "R43", "R44"
      ) ~ "Small Business Research",

      `Award Type` %in% c(
        "R13", "R25"
      ) ~ "Conferences & Research Education",

      TRUE ~ `Award Type`
    ),

    `Award Types` = case_when(
      `Award Category` == "Research Projects" ~
        "R01, R03, R21, R34, R37, R56, RF1",

      `Award Category` == "Cooperative / Multi-component Research" ~
        "U01, R61, R33, UG3, R18",

      `Award Category` == "Career Development & Transition" ~
        "K01, K08, K23, K24, R00",

      `Award Category` == "Training & Fellowships" ~
        "T32, F30, D43",

      `Award Category` == "Centers & Large Research Programs" ~
        "P30, P50, U48, UM1",

      `Award Category` == "Small Business Research" ~
        "R41, R42, R43, R44",

      `Award Category` == "Conferences & Research Education" ~
        "R13, R25",

      TRUE ~ `Award Type`
    ),

    `mHealth` = case_when(
      `mhealth_classification` == "mHealth-related" ~
        "mHealth-related",
      TRUE ~ "Not mHealth-related"
    ),
    `Start Date` = as.Date(
      coalesce(
        as.character(mdy(`Start Date`)),
        as.character(ymd_hms(`Start Date`))
      )
    )
  )

data_demo <- read.csv("scholar176_with_demographic.csv")

```

## Overall

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


## Funding Agency

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  group_by(agency) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


## Participants' Career Stage

```{r, echo=FALSE}
demo_summary <- 
  data_demo |>
  mutate(stage = factor(stage)) |> 
    group_by(stage) |> 
    reframe(`Population (total # of people)` = n())

data |> 
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("early-career", "mid-career", "late-career", "others"))) |> 
  group_by(stage) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  left_join(demo_summary, by = "stage") |> 
  arrange(desc(`Population (total # of people)`)) |> 
  gt()
```

## Award Type

### NIH

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  filter(agency == "NIH") |> 
  group_by(`Award Category`, `Award Types`) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```



### NSF

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  filter(agency == "NSF") |> 
  group_by(`Award Category`) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


## Across Time

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |> 
  mutate(
    start_year = year(ymd(`Start Date`))
  ) |> 
  group_by(start_year) |> 
  reframe(Amount = sum(Amount),
          Counts = n()) |> 
  gt()
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=.6}
yearly_data <- data |>
  mutate(
    start_year = year(
      parse_date_time(
        trimws(as.character(`Start Date`)),
        orders = c("mdy", "ymd HMS", "ymd"),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(start_year)) |>
  group_by(start_year) |>
  summarise(
    Amount = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    Counts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(start_year)

ggplot(yearly_data, aes(x = start_year, y = Amount)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3B6C8E", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yearly_data$start_year) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual NIH & NSF Funding",
    subtitle = "Total award amount by start year",
    x = "Start Year",
    y = "Total Funding",
    caption = "Source: NIH & NSF award data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=.6}
ggplot(yearly_data, aes(x = start_year, y = Counts)) +
  geom_line(color = "#3B6C8E", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#3B6C8E", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yearly_data$start_year) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual NIH & NSF Award Counts",
    x = "Start Year",
    y = "Number of Awards",
    caption = "Source: NIH & NSF award data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


## mHealth-related Funding

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data |>
  mutate(
    start_year = year(
      parse_date_time(
        trimws(as.character(`Start Date`)),
        orders = c("mdy", "ymd HMS", "ymd"),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(start_year)) |>
  group_by(start_year) |>
  summarise(
    `mHealth-related Amount` =
      sum(Amount[mHealth == "mHealth-related"], na.rm = TRUE),

    `mHealth-related Counts` =
      sum(mHealth == "mHealth-related", na.rm = TRUE),

    `mHealth-unrelated Amount` =
      sum(Amount[mHealth == "Not mHealth-related"], na.rm = TRUE),

    `mHealth-unrelated Counts` =
      sum(mHealth == "Not mHealth-related", na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(start_year) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Annual Funding by mHealth Relevance",
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    start_year = "Start Year",
    `mHealth-related Amount` = "mHealth-related Amount",
    `mHealth-related Counts` = "mHealth-related Counts",
    `mHealth-unrelated Amount` = "mHealth-unrelated Amount",
    `mHealth-unrelated Counts` = "mHealth-unrelated Counts"
  ) |>
  fmt_currency(
    columns = c(
      `mHealth-related Amount`,
      `mHealth-unrelated Amount`
    ),
    currency = "USD",
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      `mHealth-related Counts`,
      `mHealth-unrelated Counts`
    ),
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=.6}
yearly_data <- data |>
  mutate(
    start_year = year(
      parse_date_time(
        trimws(as.character(`Start Date`)),
        orders = c("mdy", "ymd HMS", "ymd"),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    ),
    mHealth_group = case_when(
      mHealth == "mHealth-related" ~ "mHealth-related",
      mHealth == "Not mHealth-related" ~ "mHealth-unrelated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(start_year), !is.na(mHealth_group)) |>
  group_by(start_year, mHealth_group) |>
  summarise(
    Amount = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    Counts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(start_year)

ggplot(
  yearly_data,
  aes(x = start_year, y = Amount, fill = mHealth_group)
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(yearly_data$start_year))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "mHealth-related" = "#3B6C8E",
      "mHealth-unrelated" = "#D98E5B"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual NIH & NSF Funding by mHealth Relevance",
    subtitle = "Total award amount by start year",
    x = "Start Year",
    y = "Total Funding",
    fill = "Award Category",
    caption = "Source: NIH & NSF award data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=.6}
ggplot(
  yearly_data,
  aes(x = start_year, y = Counts, color = mHealth_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(yearly_data$start_year))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "mHealth-related" = "#3B6C8E",
      "mHealth-unrelated" = "#D98E5B"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual NIH & NSF Award Counts by mHealth Relevance",
    subtitle = "Number of awards by start year",
    x = "Start Year",
    y = "Number of Awards",
    color = "Award Category",
    caption = "Source: NIH & NSF award data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
